mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sediment_job (platform, bot_id, group_id, trigger_kind, idempotent_key, payload, status, retry_count) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{triggerKind}, #{idempotentKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, trigger_kind AS triggerKind, idempotent_key AS idempotentKey, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, output_ref AS outputRef, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sediment_job WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, trigger_kind AS triggerKind, idempotent_key AS idempotentKey, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, output_ref AS outputRef, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sediment_job WHERE status = 'pending' OR (status = 'failed' AND retry_count < #{retryMax}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sediment_job SET status = 'processing' WHERE id = #{id} AND (status = 'pending' OR (status = 'failed' AND retry_count < #{retryMax}))
UPDATE sediment_job SET status = 'failed', retry_count = retry_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, trigger_kind AS triggerKind, idempotent_key AS idempotentKey, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, output_ref AS outputRef, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sediment_job WHERE status = 'processing' AND updated_at < #{timeoutBefore} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, trigger_kind AS triggerKind, idempotent_key AS idempotentKey, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, output_ref AS outputRef, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sediment_job WHERE status = 'failed' AND retry_count >= #{retryMax} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sediment_job SET status = 'pending', retry_count = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sediment_job WHERE status = 'done' AND updated_at < #{cutoff} LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, trigger_kind AS triggerKind, idempotent_key AS idempotentKey, payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, output_ref AS outputRef, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM sediment_job WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id
